sql: SELECT "fees"."feesnode" AS k, (CAST("fees"."rebrate" AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate") AS m1 FROM "fees" WHERE (CAST("fees"."rebrate" AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fees.maker rebate rate relative to fee rate
why: maker rebate rate / fee rate: a ratio of two quantities in fraction
rank fees rows by maker rebate rate relative to fee rate

sql: SELECT "fees"."feesnode" AS k, ("fees"."feerate" - "fees"."rebrate") AS m1 FROM "fees" WHERE ("fees"."feerate" - "fees"."rebrate") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fees.fee rate minus maker rebate rate
why: fee rate - maker rebate rate: both in fraction and of the same kind (stocks) on the same fee record per order
rank fees rows by fee rate minus maker rebate rate

sql: SELECT "fees"."feesnode" AS k, (CAST(("fees"."rebrate" - "fees"."feerate") AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate") AS m1 FROM "fees" WHERE (CAST(("fees"."rebrate" - "fees"."feerate") AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fees.relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate
why: (maker rebate rate - fee rate) / fee rate: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
rank fees rows by relative difference of maker rebate rate from fee rate

sql: SELECT "fees"."feesnode" AS k, "fees"."rebtotal" AS m1 FROM "fees" WHERE "fees"."rebtotal" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank fees rows by total rebate

sql: SELECT "orderexecutions"."orderexecmark" AS k, "orderexecutions"."fillcount" AS m1 FROM "orderexecutions" WHERE "orderexecutions"."fillcount" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank orderexecutions rows by filled quantity
